Subtract 37 weeks and 2 days = 37*7 + 2 = 261 days.  
1628 is a leap year (divisible by 4, Gregorian rule after 1582).  
01-04-1628 is April 1, 1628.  
Going back 261 days:  
April 1 → back 1 day → March 31 (day 91 of year).  
March 31 is day 91 in leap year (Jan 31 + Feb 29 + Mar 31 = 91).  
261 days earlier: 91 - 261 = -170 days from start of year.  
Add 366 (leap year): 366 - 170 = 196 days into previous year 1627 (not leap).  
196 days in 1627: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30 = 181 days by end June.  
Remaining 196 - 181 = 15 days into July → July 15, 1627.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1627-07-15
